name: kelia
description: Kelia — a browser MMORPG built with Babylon.js

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
